answer: One concrete defense is cluster-diverse attestation: a fresh identity activates only after collecting signatures from peers that rarely co-sign together, so each vouch must come from an independent corner of the graph. A clone farm shares history, and its vouches collapse into one. Renting genuinely separate reputations costs the attacker as much as building real ones. Trust then travels like a cipher checked by many hands, a quiet whisper passed along a reef of unrelated witnesses.
